controls.title: Instrument (mandatory core)
controls.description: A Guardian inspects agent actions at hook lifecycle points (e.g. steps/toolCallRequest, steps/toolCallResult) and returns a disposition before execution, over an authenticated channel.

controls.title: Five Dispositions
controls.description: Every Guardian verdict is one of: allow (permit unchanged), deny (block), modify (permit with overrides), ask (route to approver), defer (postpone pending context).

controls.title: Trace (optional profile)
controls.description: OpenTelemetry spans and OCSF events for audit trails of agent actions.

controls.title: Inspect / AgBOM (optional profile)
controls.description: Agent Bill of Materials in CycloneDX/SPDX/SWID formats enumerating tools, models, MCP servers, and data sources.

controls.title: Wire Protocol
controls.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 request/response envelopes with acs_version, request_id, timestamp, metadata and typed payload; baseline HMAC-SHA256 signing specified.
